name: Enrique Dussel
shortBio: Argentine-Mexican philosopher and primary architect of the Philosophy of Liberation, who critiqued Eurocentric modernity's ontological totality from the exteriority of the colonized victim.
centralQuestion: What is an ethical philosophy constructed not from the imperial center, but from the geopolitical exteriority and suffering of the oppressed?

keyWorks.title: Philosophy of Liberation
keyWorks.description: Systematic treatise proposing the 'analectical' method, prioritizing the metaphysical exteriority of the Other over imperial ontology.

keyWorks.title: 1492: The Concealment of the Other
keyWorks.description: Historical-philosophical deconstruction showing that Descartes' ego cogito was historically founded upon the imperial ego conquiro.

keyWorks.title: Ethics of Liberation in the Age of Globalization and Exclusion
keyWorks.description: Architectural ethical framework grounding normative validity in the production, reproduction, and development of vulnerable human life.
